title: 🔐 Step 1: Secure Multi-Tenant Authentication
text: Welcome to CoachGenie, the all-in-one Enterprise Coaching Management System. We begin with secure multi-tenant authentication. Simply enter your unique institute code 'demo', administrative email, and password to securely log into your dedicated portal.

title: 📊 Step 2: Executive Overview Dashboard
text: This is the Executive Dashboard. Institute directors and branch managers get a high-level operational overview in real-time, showcasing active students, lead conversion funnels, running batches, monthly revenue statistics, dynamic fee collection charts, and classroom attendance heatmaps.

title: 🎯 Step 3: Leads CRM & Inquiry Pipeline
text: In the Leads and CRM module, coaching centers can track incoming student inquiries across multiple channels, manage counselor follow-ups, organize leads by pipeline status, filter by source, and convert prospective candidates into confirmed enrolments with one click.

title: 📝 Step 4: Admissions & Enrolment Processing
text: The Admissions module streamlines student onboarding. Staff can process new admission applications, verify student identity documents, assign roll numbers, allocate courses, and track the entire admission approval workflow transparently.

title: 🎓 Step 5: Student Directory & 360° Profiles
text: The Students Directory maintains a 360-degree digital record of every enrolled student. It includes parent contact details, active batch enrollments, attendance history, past examination scores, fee installment status, and growth analytics.

title: 📅 Step 6: Batches & Course Management
text: The Batches module allows administrators to configure academic batches, set maximum student capacities, assign expert faculty and subject mentors, define syllabus tracks, and manage student batch transitions effortlessly.

title: ⏰ Step 7: Class Sessions & Lecture Scheduling
text: Under Sessions and Timetables, institutes can plan daily and weekly lecture calendars, schedule recurring classroom or online sessions, avoid faculty timing conflicts, and notify students about upcoming classes.

title: 📋 Step 8: Daily Live Attendance
text: The Attendance module facilitates fast and accurate daily student check-ins. Faculty can quickly mark Present, Absent, or Late with a single click, triggering instant automated SMS and WhatsApp alerts to parents.

title: 📈 Step 9: Attendance Reports & Analytics
text: In Attendance Reports, coaching management can inspect monthly attendance percentages, detect chronic absenteeism patterns, export printable attendance registers, and monitor classroom engagement trends.

title: 🏆 Step 10: Exams, Tests & Scorecard Management
text: The Exams module manages chapter tests, weekly assessments, and mock entrance exams. Teachers can schedule test dates, record subject-wise marks, generate automated rank lists, and deliver downloadable report cards to parents.

title: ✨ Step 11: AI Student Growth Cards
text: AI Growth Cards leverage machine learning to analyze every student's assessment trajectory over time, highlighting strong topics, areas needing remedial attention, and predicting final exam readiness.

title: 💳 Step 12: Fees Management & Invoicing
text: The Fees module provides a complete financial ledger for coaching institutes. Administrators can configure flexible fee structures, track upcoming and overdue installments, record cash or online payments, and generate branded GST invoices.

title: 💼 Step 13: Subscription & Billing Settings
text: Under Billing and Subscription Settings, institute owners can monitor their software tier, review historical billing invoices, configure payment gateway credentials, and manage license scaling seamlessly.

title: 🔔 Step 14: Broadcasts & Notification Center
text: The Notifications Center allows administrators to broadcast critical announcements, emergency holiday alerts, exam schedules, and fee reminders across SMS, Email, and in-app feeds to students, parents, and staff.

title: 🤖 Step 15: AI Intelligence & Predictive Analytics
text: CoachGenie's AI Analytics delivers next-generation intelligence: predicting admission conversion likelihood, calculating batch health scores, detecting early dropout risks, and providing actionable revenue forecasts.

title: ⚙️ Step 16: Staff Management & Role Permissions
text: In Settings and User Management, institute directors can onboard staff members, assign granular role permissions for Admins, Counselors, Tutors, and Coaches, and customize institute branding.

title: 📖 Step 17: In-App Documentation & Guides
text: The Documentation module contains step-by-step operating guidelines, standard operating procedures, and feature tutorials, helping institute personnel master the software with zero learning curve.

title: ✨ Step 18: Summary & All-in-One Power of CoachGenie
text: In conclusion, CoachGenie connects every facet of coaching operations: from inquiry to admission, batches to attendance, exams to fees, and AI analytics to growth. Elevate your coaching institute with CoachGenie today. Thank you for watching.
